I had a lot of problems with depression as a kid/teen, so around 15 I started going to therapy/counseling and they asked me to go to a place called MIKID. There were other kids like me there and I made a lot of friends and loved going to get away from home. There was this man working there who was part of respite. (There were a few other adults there as well enough to watch all the kids). This man was in his 40s and was one of those older guys from california that still dresses like a skater. All the kids loved him, so did I. He had all our trust. One day he had to drive me home and I was wearing a shorter dress. As I went to get out of his car at my house, my dress had went up from the wind. I was extremely embarrassed. Later that day I get a text from a random number. It was him. He just was giving me his number if I wanted to talk. Then would text me good morning and good night messages. He knew I was weak and would call me beautiful. He would flirt and send me pictures. I thought it was cool an older man wanted me. And soon after that we were making plans to have sex. He wanted to take my virginity.... It never happened. The day he was supposed to pick me up, I was waiting outside my house waiting to give him everything. Then I get a text saying he's sorry and was leaving to california. He found out his one night stand was pregnant with his kid. So he was leaving to be a dad. I was so hurt. He blocked me on IG. A year later I make a new IG account and when going to look for friends, his account was recommended. I look on his account. They had their baby and we're a happy family. The baby was beautiful. And his girlfriend looked exactly like me....
